name: bot-reply-keyboard-menu
title: Chat reply-keyboard menu over gRPC
description: Expose a bot chat's active bottom reply keyboard (replyMarkupShowKeyboard) through the existing GetInlineMenu RPC: additively return menu kind, reply rows and keyboard flags; resolve message_id=0 via chat.reply_markup_message_id. No new RPC, no Web App execution.
creator: killbus
